glossary.definition: The planned time between calibrations of an instrument, set by the organization and recorded in the register.

The property of a measurement result whereby it can be related to a reference through a documented unbroken chain of calibrations, each contributing to the measurement uncertainty (NIST, adopting the VIM definition).
The list of instruments in scope with identity, owner, interval, status and attached certificates.
A calibration result outside the limits the organization accepts for the instrument.
The role accountable for decisions and records in a defined workflow.
The person who uses or looks after the instrument and answers for its condition between calibrations.
The person who checks returned evidence and decides whether the result is acceptable for the intended use.
The person who manages the schedule, suppliers and register.
